summary: Comprehensive testing of CAPEX Portal iteration 27 features: Theme picker restored in Settings page for all users, Admin Dashboard Themes tab, Enhanced User Creation Form with Employee ID/Mobile/conditional Plant/Department/Map to DH fields, User table with new columns, and backend validation for user creation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 27 features tested and working. Settings page has theme picker restored for all users with checkmark on selected theme. Admin Dashboard has Themes tab for admin theme management. Admin User table shows Emp ID, Mobile, Dept/Plant, Mapped DH columns. Admin Create User form has Email, Name, Employee ID, Mobile, Password, Role fields. When Role=User: Plant, Department, and Map to DH fields appear (all mandatory). When Role=DH: Plant and Department appear (mandatory), NO Map to DH. When Role=Buyer: NO Plant/Department/Map to DH fields. Backend validates: employee_id uniqueness, plant/dept mandatory for user/DH roles, mapped_dh_id mandatory for user role. GET /api/admin/department-heads returns list of DHs for mapping dropdown.
